question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

We requested grandmother to __extend __her visit.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"extend"** means to make something longer or larger; to prolong. (बढ़ाना)

 
 
• **Example: **We decided to **extend** our vacation by a few more days.
 
 
 
• **"Curtail"** refers to reducing in extent or quantity; to cut short. (घटाना)
 
 
• **Example: **The government plans to** curtail** public spending in order to reduce the deficit.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'extend'** is **'curtail'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Imperil** (खतरे में डालना): To put at risk of being harmed or destroyed.

 
 
• **Example:** Reckless driving can** imperil **not only your life but also the lives of others.
 
 
 
• **Assail** (आक्रमण करना): To attack violently.
 
 
• **Example: **The army was ready to **assail** the enemy at dawn.
 
 
 
• **Bewail** (विलाप करना): To express deep sorrow or regret over.
 
 
• **Example:** The poet** bewails** the loss of his youth in his latest collection of poems.
